title.purpose: The app shell's own title only ("Log Explorer") — not used for any other heading.

body.purpose: Default size for filters, table cells (non-ID/time), inspector prose, form labels.

label.purpose: Structural/navigational text only — table column headers, small captions. Never body content.

data.purpose: Timestamps and every identifier field (Trace/Span/Correlation/Journey/Event ID) — character-width alignment matters here.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Understated; used sparingly, never as the default way to indicate a raised surface.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: The heavier of only two shadow values in the entire system; reserved for the rare functional case, never decorative.

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/border-color transitions on buttons and interactive cells.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled, high-emphasis action — e.g. Search.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; background: #2359d1; color: #ffffff; transition: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1a48ad; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2359d1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Non-destructive, non-primary action — e.g. a settings-panel trigger.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d8dce3; color: #1a1d23; transition: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f0f2f5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2359d1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #eaf1fe; border-color: #2359d1; color: #2359d1; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quietest tier — auxiliary actions (e.g. Clear, Pause).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; background: transparent; color: #5b6270; transition: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f0f2f5; color: #1a1d23; }

components.name: Severity Badge
components.description: Dot + text label, never color alone. Five variants (error/warn/info/debug/trace) share this structure with different colors.
components.css: .ds-severity { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-severity-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; flex-shrink: 0; background: currentColor; } .ds-severity-error { color: #b3261e; }

components.name: Results Table Row — Selected
components.description: The selected-row treatment: accent-tint background + 4px accent left rail, must survive hover.

components.name: Inspector Tab
components.description: Flat text tab, 2px bottom-border indicator when selected — no pill/box background.
components.css: .ds-tab { appearance: none; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; padding: 12px 8px; margin-bottom: -1px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #5b6270; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #1a1d23; } .ds-tab-selected { color: #2359d1; border-bottom-color: #2359d1; }

narrative.overview: Log Explorer's current, frozen functional baseline is a precision control surface, not a marketing surface — built for someone who reads it dozens of times a day, under time pressure, looking for one specific answer. Every visible element earns its place through information value, not expression: a single restrained accent marks state (selection, focus, active), severity is never color-only, and the interface stays flat and quiet so the data — not the chrome around it — is what the eye lands on. This is deliberately the opposite of a 'generated dashboard' aesthetic: no gradients, no card-in-card nesting, no oversized whitespace, no decorative iconography. Density and legibility are treated as the same goal, not a tradeoff.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, used only to mark state — never as decoration
Flat surfaces, 1px borders instead of elevation, near-zero shadow use
Monospace reserved for timestamps, identifiers, and query/stack-trace text; everything else is the system sans stack
Severity and state are always dual-coded, never color alone
Dense 4/8px spacing scale used with total consistency

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only color in the system that means 'you did something' or 'this is active.' It never appears as a background tint on a static, non-interactive, non-selected element.

rules.name: The Never-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every severity, selection, or state cue pairs its color with a second signal — text, an icon, a border-shape change, or an aria-* attribute.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Exactly two font families exist in the entire system: the OS sans stack for prose/labels, and the mono stack for exact data. No third font, no display face, no webfont load.

rules.name: The Border-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is never the default way to separate content. A 1px border or a background-tint step does the job first; a shadow is reserved for the rare functional case, not routine 'raised card' styling.

dos: Do use Signal Blue only to mean 'selected, active, or focused' — never as decoration.
Do pair every severity/state color with a second, non-color signal.
Do keep the results table a real semantic <table> with fixed layout.
Do reserve monospace exclusively for timestamps, identifiers, and query/stack-trace text.
Do communicate structure/grouping with borders and background-tint steps before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep the 4/8px spacing scale exact — no off-scale spacing values.
donts: Don't add a second accent color.
Don't introduce card-in-card nesting, gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative icon tiles.
Don't reduce table font-size to achieve a denser layout — density changes padding only.
Don't let a hover state visually erase a selected or context-root row.
Don't use a shadow as the default way to indicate a raised/grouped surface.
